processing_description.nature: Automated credit scoring from bank statement data
processing_description.scope: All loan applicants in India and the EU
processing_description.context: Data arrives through an account aggregator with per-purpose consent

necessity_assessment.less_intrusive_alternative: Use a 6-month transaction window instead of 24 months
necessity_assessment.lawful_basis: DPDP s.6 consent; GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) and Art. 22(2)(a)

risks.description: Model denies credit to applicants from thin-file segments without human review
risks.mitigation: Human review of every decline; reason codes shown to the applicant; DPDP Rule 13(3) algorithmic due diligence

risks.description: Bank statements retained after the loan decision with no retention limit
risks.mitigation: Delete raw statements 90 days after decision; keep derived features only
